title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Terms: Conversion to a Permanent Larkspur Residency
content:
**Article 1.** A guest of the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement who becomes a permanent Larkspur resident earns a conversion credit on the new residency.

**Article 2.** The new residency — an Independent Living Residency Agreement, an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement or a Memory Care Residency Agreement — must belong to the same customer and must have moved in, and the conversion is recorded with the new residency's move-in date as the conversion date. Where the guest moves in directly from the stay, the stay's check-out date is recorded as the day before the conversion date.

**Article 3.** A completed stay converts only if the new residency's move-in is within the conversion window of the stay type after check-out. The conversion window is counted in calendar days from the check-out date, the check-out date being day 0, and a move-in on the last day of the window still converts; a guest moving in directly from the stay converts without a window. The check-out date read is the one recorded on the stay.

**Article 4.** The conversion credit equals the nightly charges of the first nights stayed, up to the maximum nights credited of the stay type, at the rate charged for them, but never more than the community fee charged on the new residency; where the new residency was charged no community fee, no conversion credit is due and the stay is not marked converted.

**Article 5.** A stay converts at most once, and a cancelled stay never converts.

## Window: boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Check-out date (day 0) | Move-in of the new residency | Day of the window | Converts |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 1 July | Day 30, the last day | Yes |
| 1 June | 2 July | Day 31 | No |
| — (moves in directly from the stay) | Any date | No window applies | Yes |

## Credit: worked figures (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) of 20 nights charged at 239.00 a night converts into an assisted living residency that was charged a community fee of 3,000.00. The stay type credits at most 14 nights, so the nightly charges of the first 14 nights are 14 times 239.00, that is 3,346.00. That exceeds the community fee, so the conversion credit is 3,000.00.

Had the new residency been charged no community fee, no conversion credit would be due and the stay would not be marked converted.
